detail.longDescription: "AI has evolved so much and so quickly beyond ChatGPT’s debut. Now, it’s not about writing the best prompts anymore. Sure it’s still important, but we’ve entered the agentic era where the “AI native” is an orchestrator of agents. Meaning, people are now increasingly managers of “talent”. However, instead of a team of people beneath you, you now manage a team of AI agents. Your work is as good as the AI agents you build. Many writers in the creative field—the novelists, the ones hoping for a traditional publishing deal—are still stuck with the notion that AI is a chatbot and people use it to generate whole novels with a click. They don’t realize that AI has moved way beyond that. They don’t realize how much they’re being left behind. AI-fluent writers are freely sharing their knowledge online. But many prefer not to due to the harassment they get from anti-AI writers. Instead of learning from the AI-fluent writers, the anti-AI writers prefer to insult them in the comments section instead. I suppose the only saving grace for these writers is that most are not corporate writers but write fiction etc. So, the consequences would not be as severe for their career growth. I hope?" https:// elizabethtai.com/2026/08/19/li fe-as-a-techwriter-in-the-ai-age/ # TechnicalWriting # AI # GenerativeAI # AIAgents # Chatbots # AgenticAI # Writing # LLMs
